subject.title: iOS: guide first launch through pairing explainer and permissions; redesign permission rows

question: Should iOS adopt the proposed explainer → optional permissions → connect sequence through the linked pull request, or should the implementation be narrowed before landing?
rationale: Permission sequencing and first-launch UX affect product onboarding, informed consent, and app scope; the maintainer label and broad linked implementation require explicit owner judgment.

options.title: Review toward landing
options.body: Resolve the linked pull request's merge state and confirm consent, accessibility, and least-privilege behavior before landing the proposed flow.

options.title: Replace with narrower change
options.body: Keep this issue canonical but replace the broad branch with a smaller pull request limited to the explainer, permission step, and shared row component.

recommendation.title: Review toward landing
recommendation.body: Resolve the linked pull request's merge state and confirm consent, accessibility, and least-privilege behavior before landing the proposed flow.

likelyOwner.reason: This person opened the product proposal and candidate implementation and is the clearest available owner for the intended onboarding direction.
